units.source_text: （我可没说什么对策之类的事，说的是我的苦处哇……

en.t: I was not talking about any sort of countermeasure; I was talking about my own hardship...

units.source_text: 沙漠中也好，沼泽地里也好，非法监禁，不合法的，

en.t: Whether in a desert or in a swamp, unlawful confinement is illegal,

units.source_text: 到哪里都不该是两样的吧！）

en.t: and that should not be any different anywhere, should it!）
